messages:
Maria G.: Heads-up — we need panel coverage for the Backend Senior hire on Tue 2026-03-31 10:00am PT. Current proposed slate: Akash, Navin, Priya, and Jordan (tentative). Can folks confirm + say if you can take scribe/debrief lead?
Akash: I can make the slot but have a calendar conflict 9:30–10:15 PT. If we push to 10:30 it's cleaner for me. Otherwise I can still join at 10 and step out briefly.
Navin: Confirmed for 10:00. Happy to be on the panel. Not able to scribe though.
Priya K.: I can scribe and capture debrief notes if no one else volunteers. Quick Q on rubric: are we using the updated token-eval weights (soft skills 20%, system design 35%, coding 45)? I remember a change last week.
recruiter-bot: Candidate: Sasha M. (phone screen passed). Interview kit uploaded: https://drive.redwood/sr-backend/sasha-kit. Calendar hold created for Tue 10:00 PT.
Maria G.: Thanks — Priya that works. Yeah we switched weights last week to coding 50%, design 30%, soft skills 20%. Priya, use the new rubric (link below) and mark any red flags separately.
Priya K.: Got it. Can someone paste the short debrief form link? I want to fill during the call.
Akash: If we keep 10:00 I can log first 45 min and hand off to Navin for the last 15 if needed. Fine with that flow.
Maria G.: Plan: keep 10:00 PT. Priya will scribe + submit debrief. Akash will cover first 45, Navin will finish. Jordan marked tentative; @recruiter-bot can you confirm Jordan's RSVP?
recruiter-bot: Jordan T. RSVP: tentative -> pinged via DM. If no response by EOD Mon we'll replace with a backup (Sam).
Priya K.: Debrief form: https://forms.redwood/interview-debrief (use dropdown "Backend Senior" and select rubric v3). I'll post notes after the interview and tag hiring-team.
Maria G.: One more small ask — please flag any infra-related red flags under "system ownership" section. We had a regression last hire where that slipped.
Navin: noted. I'll be explicit on operational tradeoffs during design section.
Maria G.: Awesome — thanks everyone. If Jordan drops, @Sam can be backup. See you Tue."
